Definition: to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to crush, be crushed, be contrite, be broken; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be crushed; 1a2) to be contrite (fig.); 1b) (Piel) to crush; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be crushed, be shattered; 1c2) to be made contrite; 1d) (Hithpael) to allow oneself to be crushed
